name: Everything Counts In Large Amounts
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Although you may never find a flawless sphere of draenethyst, you will undoubtedly uncover various imperfect fragments of the draenethyst in your exploration of these lands.

While it is doubtful that Kum'isha will be able to use the flawed fragments to return home, the pieces may serve other, useful purposes for the draenei.

Return any piece of flawed draenethyst fragments that you may find and I shall reward you.
narrative.objectives: Bring Kum'isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments and be rewarded for each one you turn in.
narrative.offerRewardText: You truly disgust me, friend. A grown man drooling over a pile of junk? Pitiful! Take your reward and get out of my sight.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you had any luck in your exploration?

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 55, 5,650 XP in all.
